blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More Filipinos are dissatisfied with the performance of the administration under President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., a September survey by the Social Weather Stations (SWS) has shown. The poll results released on Friday indicated that 42 percent of adult Filipinos are “dissatisfied with the general performance” of the administration, four points above the 38 percent of Filipinos who are satisfied. Eighteen percent of the respondents are neither satisfied nor dissatisfied. “It is the second-lowest rating of the Marcos Jr. administration, after the record-low poor -13 in March 2026,” the pollster noted.
